ana.name: Ana Reyes
ana.bio: Calm and practical, hides her fear by working. Eli once stitched her hand during a Force 9 gale.
ana.intro: Ana is pinned beneath a collapsed surgical shelving unit, her leg trapped against the deck drain. Her breathing is shallow.

choices.help: HELP ANA (Needs Pry Bar -> Hold E 6s -> Give Stimulant 2s)
choices.leave: TAKE HER POCKET BATTERY & LEAVE (+20 POWER)

steps.needPryBar: Pinned under heavy steel shelving. You need a PRY BAR from a Workshop or Storage chest.
steps.leverShelf: HOLD [E] WITH PRY BAR TO LEVER SHELVING (6s, +15 NOISE/s)
steps.needStim: The shelf is off, but Ana is in shock. Find the STIMULANT in the Medical Bay cabinet.

rewardHelp.msg: Ana presses a field medkit into your palm (+20 HEALTH). "Go, Nora. I know the back stairs to the helideck."

rewardLeave.msg: You unclip the battery pack from her belt (+20 POWER) and step back into the corridor without looking at her eyes.

ana.savedLine: "Eli stitched my palm two winters ago. I'm not letting his sister die down here. Meet me at the chopper."
ana.leftRadio: [RADIO - ANA]: "Nora... the water's coming through the drain. Tell your mother Eli was brave."

bix.name: Bix Okafor
bix.bio: Chatty, anxious, jokes when scared. Heard Eli's last transmission from the cavern.
bix.intro: Bix is crouched behind the main transceiver rack, hands shaking as sparks spit from a torn patch panel.

choices.help: REPAIR PATCH PANEL (Reconnect 3 cable pairs using clue note)
choices.leave: CUT THE TRANSCEIVER & LEAVE (60s quiet rig: 2x noise decay)

steps.puzzlePrompt: PRESS [E] TO OPEN PATCH PANEL PUZZLE

rewardHelp.msg: The carrier wave locks in. Bix beams: "Got the beacon! I'm patching the helideck route straight to your HUD!"

rewardLeave.msg: You pull the main breaker. The radio room goes dead silent. For 60 seconds your noise decays twice as fast.

bix.savedLine: "Still the best electrician on Halcyon Deep! I'll keep the pilot holding on channel 16—see you topside!"
bix.leftRadio: [RADIO - BIX]: "Static's eating the band... if anyone's listening onshore, we were ninety klicks out..."

chen.name: Chen Wei
chen.bio: Gruff, loyal to the machines. Saw its face for one second and has not forgiven himself.
chen.intro: Cold black seawater sloshes knee-deep against a jammed bulkhead door. Chen is trapped on the other side, rapping a wrench against the steel.

choices.help: DRAIN FLOODED BULKHEAD (Turn 3 valves in wall-chart order, 3s each)
choices.leave: STRIP HIS RESERVE CELLS & LEAVE (+25 POWER)

steps.valvePrompt: HOLD [E] TO TURN VALVE (3s, +25 NOISE) — CHECK WALL CHART FOR ORDER

rewardHelp.msg: Chen throws the auxiliary tie-breaker (+30 POWER). "Backup bus is yours, kid. Don't look at its face."

rewardLeave.msg: You pry the reserve lithium cells out of the external rack (+25 POWER) and leave the bulkhead sealed.

chen.savedLine: "I looked at him for one second by the manifold. He didn't want to hurt me, Nora—he just couldn't bear being seen."
chen.leftRadio: [RADIO - CHEN]: "Water's over the turbines now. Keep moving, kid. Don't look back."

dara.name: Dara Holt
dara.bio: Gentle and terrified, hiding. Used to leave warm soup out for Eli on night shifts.
dara.intro: The insulated chiller door is latched from the inside. Through the frosted vent you hear Dara whispering a prayer, too terrified of loud noises to unbolt it.

choices.help: WAIT QUIETLY BY HER DOOR (Stay within 3m with Noise < 10 for 10s)
choices.leave: RAID HER EMERGENCY RATION STASH & LEAVE (+3 FOOD)

steps.calmPrompt: STAND WITHIN 3m WITH NOISE UNDER 10 FOR 10 SECONDS

rewardHelp.msg: The heavy latch clicks open. Dara hugs you briefly and hands you two warm ration packs (+2 FOOD).

rewardLeave.msg: You wrench the outer supply bin open, grab three ration tins (+3 FOOD), and leave Dara bolted inside.

dara.savedLine: "I left hot soup by the moon pool every night after he vanished. The bowl was always empty by dawn. Let's go home."
dara.leftRadio: [RADIO - DARA]: "It's outside the freezer door... it's crying, Nora. Why is it crying?"
